# Fixtures

- `hibp/breach_adobe.json` — public breach metadata from `GET /api/v3/breach/Adobe` (captured 2026-11-05).
- `hibp/breachedaccount_multiple.json` — response for HIBP's documented test address `multiple-breaches@hibp-integration-tests.com` using the documented test key (captured 2026-11-05).

Provider adapter tests use inline mock responses that mirror the live field structure with synthetic values. No fixture contains data about a real private individual.
